publisher: NHS England, now Department of Health and Social Care
release: Adult Social Care Activity and Finance Report, England
bank: none, this dataset has no fetch or transform script
provenance: Hand-authored and committed in a7bbed2. The 25 rows were transcribed from the 2023/24 edition. The 2024/25 edition is published, and the series has moved publisher from NHS England to DHSC, so a rebuild has to follow the move as well as the year.
manualFields: every row: no generator exists, so nothing regenerates when the report publishes
blockedOn: no fetch or transform script exists for this dataset, so there is nothing to run. Building one widens coverage past the 25 hand-picked areas, which changes the comparison set behind every pressure-index percentile the site publishes.
